title: Build from Source fails as error: 'all_of' is not a member of 'std'
bug_description:
TLDR Building from sources fails since 'all_of' is now a part of algorithm and not 'std' .
Adding `#include <algorithm> `in HeaderOnlyArrayRef.h solves this.
